segments.ja398:1.1: Rājā te bhattaṃ pāhesi, suciṃ maṃsūpasecanaṃ;
segments.ja398:1.3: Maghadevasmiṃ [makhādevasmiṃ (sī. pī.), māghadevasmiṃ (ka.)] adhivatthe, ehi nikkhamma bhuñjassu.
segments.ja398:2.3: Tvañca māṇava bhikkhā ca [bhakkhosi (syā.), bhakkhāva (ka.)], ubho bhakkhā bhavissatha.
segments.ja398:4.1: Laddhāya yakkhā [laddhāyaṃ yakkha (sī. syā. pī.)] tava niccabhikkhaṃ, suciṃ paṇītaṃ rasasā upetaṃ;
segments.ja398:4.3: Bhikkhañca te āhariyo naro idha, sudullabho hehiti bhakkhite [khādite (sī. syā. pī.)] mayi.
segments.ja398:5.1: Mameva [mamesa (sī. pī.)] sutano attho, yathā bhāsasi māṇava;
segments.ja398:5.3: Mayā tvaṃ samanuññāto, sotthiṃ passāhi mātaraṃ.
segments.ja398:6.1: Khaggaṃ chattañca pātiñca, gacchamādāya [gacchevādāya (sī. syā. pī.)] māṇava;
segments.ja398:6.3: Sotthiṃ passatu te mātā, tvañca passāhi mātaraṃ.
segments.ja398:7.1: Evaṃ yakkha sukhī hohi, saha sabbehi ñātibhi;
segments.ja398:7.3: Dhanañca me adhigataṃ, rañño ca vacanaṃ katanti.

lines: Maghadevasmiṃ adhivattheti maghadevoti vaṭarukkho vuccati, tasmiṃ adhivattheti devataṃ ālapati.
Taṃ sutvā yakkho “imaṃ purisaṃ vañcetvā antochāyāya paviṭṭhaṃ khādissāmī”ti cintetvā dutiyaṃ gāthamāha –
Tvañca māṇava bhikkhā ca, ubho bhakkhā bhavissathā”ti.
“Laddhāya yakkhā tava niccabhikkhaṃ, suciṃ paṇītaṃ rasasā upetaṃ;
Bhikkhañca te āhariyo naro idha, sudullabho hehiti bhakkhite mayī”ti.
Tattha thullamatthanti appakena kāraṇena mahantaṃ atthaṃ jahissasīti dasseti.
Nāharissantīti ito paṭṭhāya maraṇasaññino hutvā na āharissanti, atha tvaṃ milātasākho viya rukkho nirāhāro dubbalo bhavissasīti.
Idaṃ vuttaṃ hoti – samma yakkha, yaṃ ahaṃ ajja āhariṃ, idaṃ tava niccabhikkhaṃ suciṃ paṇītaṃ uttamaṃ rasena upetaṃ laddhāgamanaṃ devasikaṃ te āgacchissati.
“sace tvaṃ imaṃ bhikkhaṃ gahetvā āgataṃ maṃ bhakkhasi, athevaṃ mayi bhakkhite bhikkhañca te āharaṇako añño naro idha sudullabho bhavissati.

Mādiso hi bārāṇasiyaṃ añño paṇḍitamanusso nāma natthi, mayi pana khādite sutanupi nāma yakkhena khādito, aññassa kassa so lajjissatī”ti bhattāharaṇakaṃ na labhissasi, atha te ito paṭṭhāya bhojanaṃ dullabhaṃ bhavissati, amhākampi rājānaṃ gaṇhituṃ na labhissasi.

Sace panidaṃ bhattaṃ bhuñjitvā maṃ pahiṇissasi, ahaṃ te rañño kathetvā nibaddhaṃ bhattaṃ pesessāmi, attānampi ca te khādituṃ na dassāmi, ahampi tava santike ṭhāne na ṭhassāmi, pādukāsu ṭhassāmi, rukkhacchāyāyampi te na ṭhassāmi, attano chattacchāyāyameva ṭhassāmi, sace pana mayā saddhiṃ virujjhissasi, khaggena taṃ dvidhā bhindissāmi, ahañhi ajja etadatthameva sajjo hutvā āgatoti.
